title: Landscape of enhancer disruption and functional screen in melanoma cells
model: A375 melanoma cells, dCas9-KRAB CRISPRi library over 805 HRR-associated enhancers (9,977 guides)
paper_calls: 66 positively and 17 negatively selected enhancers at FDR 0.05
barcs_calls: 226 enhancers at FDR 0.10 (21 enriched, 205 depleted); 259 against the control null (71 enriched)
verdict: BARCS confirms the paper's three validated tumour-suppressive enhancers (E_349, E_409 and E_156 near PTEN) at FDR 0.10. It keeps only 20 of the 66 positively selected enhancers by model FDR (71 enriched against the control null), and it calls many more depleted enhancers than the paper reports.
